title: Verify: preload.test.ts BootScene planner and fallback unit tests
summary: BootScene preload and resolveKey tests with mocked Phaser
description: Add BootScene tests to game/tests/preload.test.ts mirroring the mocking pattern of game/frontend/tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Given known bed and unknown ghost refs, when preload runs, then load.image is called once for objects/bed and console.warn names objects/ghost
Given unknown id, when resolveKey runs, then FALLBACK_KEY returned
Given loaderror on a known id, when resolveKey runs, then FALLBACK_KEY returned
technical_constraints: vi.mock phaser (Scene class with events.once), the content module, ../store/gameStore, ./events and ./effectContext paths of BootScene using absolute frontend paths

steps.action: Add vi.mock for 'phaser' (default Scene class with events={once:vi.fn()}, Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN), for the frontend src/runtime/content (scene with objects/bed and objects/ghost, manifest with objects/bed and objects/desk), and stub modules for store/gameStore, phaser/events and phaser/effectContext
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts

steps.action: Import BootScene and FALLBACK_KEY from ../frontend/src/phaser/BootScene; stub boot.load={image,on} and boot.make.graphics fake; test preload calls image once with ('objects/bed','assets/<manifest path>') and warns 'unknown asset ref: objects/ghost'; test resolveKey('nope') and a loaderror-failed id return FALLBACK_KEY
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts -t BootScene
